title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-28
lineage: Akai GX636>Apogee Mini Me @24bit/96kHz > Apogee mini DAC(monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One Audio Card > Wavelab 5.0 > FLAC. Pow-r3 Dither in Weiss-Saracon FLAC Level 8 in Trader's Lil Helper Meta-Data with Tag&ReName
source: SBD MR>R@ 7 1/2 ips. Tape stock:Maxell UD35-7 tape.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with standout Truckin', El Paso, Cumberland Blues, Sugar Magnolia and a soaring Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard quality, despite a few volume spikes and occasional cuts. Musically the concert shines – early Truckin' bites hard, El Paso is beautifully slow, Cumberland Blues is called the reviewer’s favorite, and the second set builds to a phenomenal Dark Star before closing with an electrifying Not Fade Away. Minor hiccups (a miscue on Cryptical and a bass‑heavy Bertha) do not detract from the overall excitement.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed, enthusiastic review rates both show and recording at five stars; the show is highlighted as exceptional with many standout moments, while recording quality is described as great overall.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality described as “really great” and crisp; occasional bass volume spike on Bertha, a cut at the end of that track, missing Wharf Rat, and a truncated Other One are noted but do not dominate the listening experience.

poor_songs: Bertha (bass volume spike and cut at end)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set flows from a punchy Truckin' through thoughtful ballads and tight harmonies, while the second set builds with Deal, Hard to Handle, and a powerful Dark Star before an exuberant Not Fade Away finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for strong guitar tone on Truckin', beautiful playing on El Paso, vocal corrections, and a soaring performance during Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted as “great” and “bonafide”; Phil’s commentary and zone are noted as highlights.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals praised on Loser, Me & Bobby McGee, King Bee; strong harmonies on Cumberland Blues mentioned.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s (T.C.) keyboard work described as excellent during the mid‑section of Dark Star and other jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum section receives compliments for keeping the energy high throughout the show.
